observations.body: The resurrection argument moves through order, coming, Kingdom, abolished powers, reign, enemies, and death.
observations.label: The Kingdom delivered to the Father

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside the kingdom delivered to the father.
observations.label: God’s Kingdom

payload.posture: Read 1 Corinthians 15:20–28 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the resurrection argument moves through order, coming, Kingdom, abolished powers, reign, enemies, and death. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: The Kingdom delivered to the Father
